max_tire.note: Fit at factory height on 18-inch wheels. 275/65R18 (≈32 in) is about the limit: owners zip-tie the front-left height-sensor wire to the frame rail and reshape the right-rear liner near the third-row heater hoses.
The common choice with Proud Rhino, Johnson or Terrafirma rods; may rub slightly at full lock, cured by heat-reshaping the liner. One owner advises staying under 32 in overall.
Lucky8 says Terrafirma's HD coil conversion clears 32–33 in tyres with minor trimming, depending on wheels and offset.

items.title: Driver airbag clockspring wiring can fracture
items.summary: Relative motion between the steering-wheel hub, column cowl and clockspring could fracture the airbag wiring; 37,142 LR3 and Range Rover Sport vehicles covered.

items.title: Fuel tank internal breather pipe
items.summary: A breather pipe grommet not made to specification can swell, crack and let the pipe detach, allowing fuel into the breather line.

items.title: Fuel tank breather pipe (follow-up)
items.summary: A further campaign on the same internal breather pipe and grommet, which can let excess fuel be discharged.

items.title: Ignition key removable out of Park
items.summary: After the ignition is switched off, the key could be removed with the shifter out of Park, failing FMVSS 114.

items.title: Automatic transmission parking pawl guide plate
items.summary: Some vehicles were built with an incorrectly manufactured parking pawl guide plate.

items.title: Seat belt buckle mountings
items.summary: Some vehicles may have incorrectly built seat belt buckle mountings.

tsbs.title: TDV6 crankshaft and crankshaft bearing concerns
tsbs.summary: Covers crank and main-bearing failures on the TDV6, caused mainly by incorrectly located bearing shells at assembly; symptoms include a seized engine, a holed block or sump, or a knock with the oil-pressure light.

tsbs.title: AMK air suspension compressor upgrade
tsbs.summary: The later AMK compressor (LR072537 kit) is a factory-approved replacement for the original Hitachi unit but needs a software update.

timeline.change: Discovery 3 revealed 2 April; British International Motor Show debut in May; UK sales from August with 2.7 TDV6 or 4.4 V8
LR3 launches in North America with the 4.4 V8 or the 216 hp 4.0 V6
Clockspring, fuel-breather and ignition-key recalls; check they were done
UK XS and GS trims replace the S (September); Discovery 3 runs the G4 Challenge
UK drops the 4.4 V8; US drops the base model and offers the V6 only in the SE
US V8 only; seven seats standard; facelift with body-colour bumpers, clear side indicators and Harman/Kardon upgrade
Final year; Discovery 4 / LR4 replaces it in September 2009

identify.intro: The same truck wears two names and several powertrains depending on market, and a few European trucks lack the air suspension and Terrain Response that define the model.

items.head: LR3 or Discovery 3
items.body: LR3 is the North American and Middle Eastern badge; elsewhere it is the Discovery 3. US trucks are petrol only: 4.4 V8 throughout, 4.0 V6 for 2005–07.

items.head: Engine badges
items.body: Tailgate badges such as 'V8 SE' show the engine and trim. A diesel in the US is a private import.

items.head: Coil-sprung base
items.body: The UK/European base model has five seats, coil springs, the 2.7 TDV6 only and no Terrain Response. A missing Terrain Response dial on the console is the giveaway.

items.head: Facelift (2008–09)
items.body: Body-colour bumpers and clear side indicator lights replace the early trucks' black plastic trim and earlier indicators.

items.head: Discovery 4 / LR4 lookalikes
items.body: The 2009-on Discovery 4 shares the body structure but has restyled front and rear lights with LEDs, a new grille and smoother bumpers.

items.head: Compressor type
items.body: Original trucks have a Hitachi air compressor; a later AMK unit means it has been replaced and the software updated.

values.intro: Cheap and flat: most LR3s sell for under $14,000, and clean, low-mileage or well-equipped trucks are the only ones that break $20,000.
values.note: Based on 24 Bring a Trailer LR3 sales from September 2025 to October 2026 ($3,250–23,000, median about $9,100). The top results were a 2007 HSE at $23,000 and a 2007 SE at $21,000; a 2008 'G4 Challenge Nevada Passage' truck sold for $16,600.
